name: newmoon
source:
he's waited his whole life for today.

the day he would be reborn.

(a short minimalist 18+ visual novel about a boy splitting himself in half and subsequently falling in love under the newmoon)

[From [url=https://neetdevil.itch.io/newmoon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他一生都在等待今天。

等待重生的这一天。

（一部简短、极简风格的18岁以上视觉小说，讲述一个男孩将自己一分为二，随后在新月之下坠入爱河的故事。）

[摘自[url=https://neetdevil.itch.io/newmoon]Itch.io[/url]]
